description: This file defines the interface for the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, providing functions for checking device availability, managing randomness seeds, synchronization, command buffer submission, and retrieving command buffers and dispatch queues for GPU operations on Apple's Metal API.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if the Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) device is available.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Sets the random number generator seed for the MPS device.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Waits for all streams on the MPS device to complete, blocking the CPU thread until GPU operations are finished.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Submits the current command buffer to execute on the MPS device.

methods.name: get_command_buffer
methods.description: Retrieves the current Metal command buffer to encode GPU commands.

methods.name: get_dispatch_queue
methods.description: Provides the dispatch queue to synchronize encoding of custom kernels with the PyTorch MPS backend.
